propositions: The autouse repository-isolation guard times out on git rev-parse HEAD during test teardown under full-suite concurrent load despite passing sequentially.

The five-second watchdog was calibrated on unloaded probes (p95 16.4ms, max 61ms) but does not account for behavior under 18-process pytest concurrency (p99 2.08s, max 3.30s under controlled load; max 1.686s observed in full suite).

Host oversubscription (load average p90 110.8, max 170; process count max 771 on 18 CPUs) causes scheduler/filesystem starvation that delays git child process execution after Popen, triggering the timeout.
The timeout is not caused by Git environment contamination, PATH issues, test-local state, or shared-repository contention alone; it correlates with host saturation intervals.
No product code defect is proven; the watchdog contract remains valid and the failure is an environment-or-config classification.
